faq.question: Is it built with Radix UI?
faq.answer: Yes, it uses Radix UI primitives under the hood via Shadcn UI, providing unstyled, accessible components.

faq.question: Is it fully responsive?
faq.answer: Absolutely. The UI is built mobile-first using Tailwind CSS.

faq.question: Does it support dark mode?
faq.answer: Yes, it respects your system preferences and includes a beautiful dark mode implementation.
